items.claim: Annotation pick swallows a multi-select change and never unpicks
"No fill" shows plainly off, not mixed, when the fill is MIXED between none and a color
items.note: question. `RangeStyle` gives the same `fill: MIXED` for none-plus-red as for red-plus-blue, so `CharacterOptions` can't tell the two apart. Marking `noFill` mixed on every MIXED would mislabel red-plus-blue, and an existing test deliberately keeps it unlit there. A fix needs `@weasel-js/text`'s range style to report whether some of the runs have no fill.

items.claim: A SelectionPanel draft that ends in a cancel stays in the scene
items.note: On a single value the claim is wrong: the kit's edit protocol sends the start value back through `onInput` before `onCancel`, so the draft is already undone, and a slider test I wrote passed before the fix too. Over a mixed selection it is a real defect: that one start value was drafted onto every node and stayed there. Drafts now carry a `cancel` (`LeafContext.drafts.cancel`, a `cancel` argument to `withDrafts`, `PanelCellScope.cancel`, `LeafWrites.cancel`) that puts each node back to its own value. Only kit settings that leave text, number or color fields live on a panel can reach this; with the defaults, only sliders draft, and a slider is disabled over a mixed selection.

items.claim: PlotDataPanel can't unset an optional color or boolean field
items.note: question. `@weasel-js/ui`'s color and boolean controls have no unset state; number and enum get theirs from `onClear`. Adding one means designing a clear control for a color swatch and a third state for a boolean, which is a UI decision outside this area.

The swatch now includes the opacity in its color, and a color edit keeps it (through `paintWithColor`). Side effect: a picked `#00ff00ff` now commits as `#00ff00`, and the existing test was updated for that.
